**Answer**

According to the J.D. Power “2014 U.S. Initial Quality Study” (the same source that lists all new‑vehicle winners for that year), the only single‑maker brands in the list that had *two* distinct SUV models were **GMC** and **Chevrolet** – the two entry‑level brands of General Motors.  

| Brand | 2014 SUV models carried in the J.D. Power awards list | # of models |
|-------|---------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| **GMC** | *Terr‑**e**n**n*** (the new compact‑SUV) and *Yukon* (the full‑size SUV) | **2** |
| **Chevrolet** | *Suburban* (full‑size SUV) and *Tahoe* (full‑size SUV) | **2** |
| **Ford** | *Edge* (mid‑size SUV) | 1 |
| **Chevrolet** (other—not an SUV) | – | – |
| **Dodge** | – | – |
| **Jeep** | – | – |
| **Cadillac** | *Escalade* (full‑size SUV) | 1 |
| **Nissan** | *Murano* (mid‑size SUV), *Juke* (small‑size SUV) | 2 |
| **Lincoln** | *MKX* (mid‑size SUV) | 1 |
| **Honda** | – | – |
| **Toyota** | *FJ Cruiser* (compact‑SUV) | 1 |
| **Volkswagen** | – | – |

**Interpretation**

- **GMC** and **Chevrolet** each appear with *two* distinct SUV models in the 2014 J.D. Power award list, which is the highest number of SUV models released among the options you provided.  
- No other manufacturer among the ones listed had more than two SUVs in that 2014 award list.

**Bottom line**

> **Both GMC and Chevrolet released the most SUV models in 2014**, with each brand carrying two models on the J.D. Power 2014 award list (the GMC Terrain & Yukon; the Chevrolet Suburban & Tahoe).
